reason: Arlo Technologies is a NYSE-listed public company (ARLO, IPO 2018, spun out of Netgear; ~376-400+ employees, HQ Carlsbad CA) that MANUFACTURES consumer smart-home security cameras and sells cloud SaaS subscriptions — it is the OEM on the wrong side of David Shake's market, not a $2M-$20M low-voltage systems integrator or electrical contractor adding a technology line.
